paper_metadata.title: (FeCoNi)75Cu25-xSix high entropy alloys prepared by mechanical alloying and spark plasma sintering: Microstructure, deformation behavior and dynamic recrystallization kinetics

evidence.quote: The present research aimed to produce (FeCoNi)75Cu25-xSix (x = 0, 5, 10, 15, 20, 25 at.%) high-entropy alloys (HEAs) using mechanical alloying (MA) and spark plasma sintering (SPS).
The percentage of the FCC2 phase rises from 5% in the Si5 alloy to 15% in the Si10 alloy based on the findings of the quantitative estimation.

An planetary ball mill was used to perform the MA process, and it ran for up to 40 h in an argon atmosphere. The ball mill cups demonstrated orbital motion, with a ball-to-powder ratio of 15:1 and a ball speed of 400 rpm.

With the exception of the Si20 alloy, which was sintered at 600 °C, 800 °C, and 1000 °C at a pressure of 40 MPa to achieve the ideal sintering conditions, all alloys were sintered at a temperature of 1000 °C under the pressure of 40 MPa.
